Source and attribution

The archive attributes this English wording to Ich und Du (1923) and files it under Dialogical Philosophy. That locator distinguishes the passage from loose internet attributions: readers can return to the named work or section to check translation, surrounding argument, and edition-specific wording.

About Martin Buber

Martin Buber (1878–1965) was an Austrian-Jewish philosopher and theologian best known for I and Thou (1923). Active in Zionist cultural politics, Hasidic storytelling, and Bible translation with Franz Rosenzweig, he later taught at Hebrew University.
